verses.raw: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates.<sup foot_note=256339>1</sup> He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses.<sup foot_note=256340>2</sup> That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
